Our Client: Is looking for a Junior/Intermediate Software Developer with expertise in Python and JavaScript. 
You can expect to work on the current ERP system, work on customer-facing custom software, improving integrations between all systems. Enabling a growth pathway for you as a software developer.  
Requirements:
1 - 2 years of Commercial software development experience.
Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, and REST API development.
Ability to code in JavaScript or TypeScript, does not need JS framework experience.
Solid understanding of software development best practices, debugging, and testing.
Nice-to-haves: 
Experience with version control (Git) and collaborative workflows.
Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS or Azure) or containerisation (e.g., Docker).
Responsibilities:
Design, develop, and deliver new features within our internal software systems.
Build and maintain integration services with external platforms and APIs, ensuring reliability and scalability.
Diagnose and resolve complex software issues across the stack.
Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code.
Collaborate with technical and non-technical teams to translate business needs into technical solutions.
Benefits: 
Strong growth environment and pathway 
Hybrid setup with flexibility
HQ Office in Ellerslie  
Competitive Salary 
Please note: 
To be considered for this position, you must have valid New Zealand work rights and be currently based in NZ.
We're looking for someone who can fully commit to this role as their primary focus. Applicants currently enrolled in a bachelor's degree (or equivalent study) won't be suitable, but graduates are encouraged to apply.
